jobs.title: Manager- Digital Merchandising
jobs.description:
Overview:  

This role is a new position creation in the India eCommerce Marketing organization to factor working on Digital Merchandising on 6 Indian customers including Rapid delivery or E\-commerce: Walmart, Amazon etc. The role will be based out of the ICC (India Capability Center, Hyderabad) and work very closely with Sydney LeCompte (Sr. Manager, Key Account Manager) based out of PepsiCo Canada office, daily. The associate will also interact with KAMs on aspects of Food and Beverages related to the business, as and when necessary. Within the GCC, the role will collaborate with the Performance Marketing team working the F\&B portfolio, the team reporting into Sarita Khanna, Deputy Director: Performance Marketing.

  

The main objective of this role is to maximize the presence of PEP items on eComm customers’ sites and ensure our items are visible and attractive to shoppers and machines (Search Engine Optimization). Its success is critical to the eComm org achieving its sales and share growth targets. The purpose of this role is to execute best\-in\-class product content to shoppers and customers, and to help maintain content excellence through content score reporting. This role’s scope encompasses all PEP India brands, products, mainly across a focused list of customers (1\-6\) and also across all content in the CA retail landscape. This role is expected to ‘own’ content quality for Canada eCommerce.

  


Responsibilities:  

The Merchandising specialist is responsible for the presence of PEP assortment online, leading the maintenance of eCommerce customers’ websites with up\-to\-date, accurate, and compelling product imagery, video, and product copy, with visibility across all PepsiCo Canada brands for Food (Quaker and Frito\-Lay) and Beverage’s business. In partnership with Digital Sales teams, he/she will ensure the correct digital assets are used for retailer websites, and ensure assets are distributed, and uploaded for new item launches and assortment enhancements.

* Execute flawless online PEP assortment that is attractive to both shoppers and machines (SEO) across specific set of customers
* Own measurement and maintenance of Content Quality scores, using Retailer methodology and DSA platforms. Be able to independently diagnose content gaps and execute accurate fixes in line with Content Quality expectations
* Lead new item setup and the refinement of product detail pages and online brand destinations
* Intermediate knowledge of internal PIM and DAM systems as well as third\-party Content Service Providers (e.g., Syndigo, Salsify)
* Use retailer platforms and DSA tools to update Brilliant Basics trackers to ensure retailer sites’ parity with in\-store packaging and assets
* Actively managing the merchandising of all Canada eCommerce retailers

  


Qualifications:  

* Marketing/digital merchandising experience— 6\+ years of experience developing and executing digital merchandising/content needs
* This role is not customer\-facing, though it is critical that he/she can problem solve day to day hurdles prior to escalating to manager.
* ECommerce mindset—understanding of how to leverage SEO and merchandising tactics to find and engage shoppers and drive conversion
* Adobe Photoshop (Beginner skill level); work with Mexico Graphic Design team to upload creative assets to retailer sites
* Understanding of data in order to ensure content is executed
* A track record of delivering results in complex, multi\-stakeholder and fluid environments
* Ability to juggle multiple priorities while ensuring flawless execution.
* This role’s scope encompasses all PEP US brands, products, and a short list of eComm customers
* Passion for executing content needs and proactively able to spot inaccuracies and fix in a timely manner

jobs.description:

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. ***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***

**Who We Are…**

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the *storytellers* bringing our characters to life, the *creators* bringing them to your living rooms and the *dreamers* creating what’s next…


From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

**Site Reliability Operations Specialist – II (SRO Team), Hyderabad**

**About Warner Bros. Discovery:**
Warner Bros. Discovery, a premier global media and entertainment company, offers audiences the world's most differentiated and complete portfolio of content, brands and franchises across television, film, streaming and gaming. The new company combines Warner Media’s premium entertainment, sports and news assets with Discovery's leading non\-fiction and international entertainment and sports businesses. For more information, please visit www.wbd.com.**Meet Our Team:**


The Site Reliability Operations (SRO) is a global team which is part of the wider Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) department who are responsible for global technology reliability and operations across Warner Bros. Discovery’s Streaming platforms.


SRO is the first point of contact for technical and operational issues within Warner Bros. Discovery’s Streaming division. The SRO teams are responsible for initiating the major incident process, triaging technical problems, conducting content QC validations and action mitigations where applicable, to provide our streaming customers a best\-in\-class service.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* The Site Reliability Operations Specialist \- II role supports an extensive suite of Live, VOD, OTT/Digital Playout via client applications. You will report to the Operations Manager and be part of a 24/7 team of other Specialists.
* You will focus on the overall stability of our streaming systems including both VOD and Live content on TNT Sports, Eurosport, Discovery Plus, HBO MAX, and CNN brands. Think Olympics, Premier League, Champions League, Tennis Grand Slams and Tour de France as a start.
* You will also learn about our Cloud infrastructure and help support our major VOD (White Lotus, Euphoria, House of Dragon) and market launch releases.
* The position requires you to be on\-site and is a shift\-based role, requiring flexibility with working hours as weekends and public holidays are some of our busiest times. For major events/launches, you may be required to work overnight.
* You will be working as part of a unified team, which consists of members from multiple disciplines. You'll be monitoring quality of service, quality of experience and non\-linear output, as well as supporting digital OTT cloud infrastructure.
* You will be expected to use your operational analytics and incident management skills to provide support for all issue areas, working with support teams/engineers for a swift resolution to any technical issues. You will also be expected to support and educate your team members about new processes, while independently keeping your technical know\-how up to date.
* Having a versatile personality and technical skillset, with the ability to stay focused and continually develop is key to being successful in this role. Successful candidates for this role need to have prior experience in leading difficult situations, staying calm, reacting quickly under pressure, and being able to execute the key responsibilities noted below.


Key Responsibilities

* Provide support during major product and content launch events.
* Recreate customer facing issues across a variety of devices
* Conduct Pre/During/Post Live checks on assets and systems for 2–4 Critical User Journeys (CUJs).
* Provide triage support by interrogating systems and escalating incidents internally for further support.
* Respond to automated alarms/alerts, carry out defined analysis, and escalate to relevant engineering teams within agreed SLAs.
* Issue communications to business users in the event of incidents and provide daily incident status reporting.
* Analyse client issues escalated by customer service and internal production/content operation teams.
* Ensure all issues are logged and tracked through to resolution, leveraging ITIL principles of Incident, Problem, and Change management.
* Ensure detailed shift handover among colleagues.
* Update department support documentation promptly to reflect all changes (Knowledgebase, Run Books, etc.).
* Support Staff Specialists and Operations Managers in the management of high\-priority outages as needed.
* Engage in regular internal stakeholder meetings (customer services, production/content operations, QA team, product owners, and engineering teams).
* Perform sanity checks on back\-end systems/front\-end platforms after deployments and releases, providing feedback to engineering teams.

**What to Bring:**

* Previous experience in digital media or technical operations environment.
* 3 – 5 years of Experience in monitoring and supporting OTT platforms
* Working knowledge of HD and SD video feed input, CMS, and EPG systems.
* Education – Preferred bachelor's degree in Digital Media, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* Working knowledge of Confluence, MS Suite, or similar computer software systems.
* Some experience in cloud environments, particularly AWS or Azure, is preferred.

**SS\&C GIDS – Lead Business Analyst**

**Company Overview**

SS\&C is a global provider of investment and financial services and software for the financial services and healthcare industries. Named to Fortune 1000 list as top U.S. company based on revenue, SS\&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut and has 20,000\+ employees in over 90 offices in 35 countries. Some 18,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest institutions to local firms, manage and account for their investments using SS\&C's products and services.


**Reports to:**

Scrum Master/Delivery Manager


**Opportunity snapshot:**

The successful candidate will perform a leadership role in the programme working alongside client\-side business analysts, business system analysts and solution architects in order to effectively perform and oversee analysis and design techniques to solve complex business solutions. .


**Job Location : Hyderabad / Pune**
-----------------------------------

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage the output of System Business analysts to ensure high quality deliverables that increase business value and align with the strategic product direction
* Assessing, validating and improving requirement quality against analysis standards and best practices.
* Substantial recent experience in complex business system analysis and functional design working across the full project lifecycle on a complex, multi\-year programme.
* Planning programme BA activities for a multi\-year complex programme
* Analysing / validating business solutions and contributing to other written business deliverables necessary to increase the business value and/or ensure quality of services and solutions
* Understanding of IT systems, databases and infrastructure including complex system architectures involving the integration of multiple systems (including third parties)
* Highly proficient and able to coach others in solution analysis techniques include Use Cases, UML Modelling Diagrams, User Interface Design, Domain Modelling, Logical data modelling and Business Rules modelling
* Functional design documentation and user story development including acceptance criteria
* Process modelling including BPMN
* Workshop facilitation and solution demonstration ‘play back’
* Requirement Traceability and change management
* Working understanding of requirement management tools (JIRA, Confluence)

**Domain Knowledge**

* Domain knowledge in one or more the following areas will assist a Lead Business Analyst in the role.
* Defined Contribution and Defined Benefit Plans Funds management
* Annuity and Pension Products
* Personal wealth investments such as Unit Trust and Managed Funds
* Platform/Wrap Account Products which enable an investor to hold assets across multiple managers and trade directly with the share market.

**Professional Experience**
---------------------------

* Lead Business System Analysts in the role typically have more than 8\+ years of formal business analysis experience, working with project teams of more than 10 people.
* Experience of working with internationally distributed teams is critical.
* Experience working within an Agile delivery environment is also an advantage.

**Other:**
----------

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent customer engagement skills.
* Driven and will engage in self\-learning.
* Willing to travel internationally, work outside local time zone hours and to spend time on client sites

**Key behaviours:**

* **Instils Trust** – contribute to building a safe learning environment in the business where the team can be listened to and understood.
* **Collaborate** – Must be able to work in a co\-operative manner with both internal and external teams and take all views and interests into account when formulating outcomes.
* **Ensure Accountability** – Must take full ownership of their assigned responsibilities and the outcomes that are generated and pursued
* **Customer Focus** – Must understand customer and partner needs from both a functional and operational perspective.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
 Anaqua is expanding its development capability in Hyderabad to support and accelerate the evolution of the RightHub platform. We are looking for a strong, delivery\-focused Product Owner to work locally with the Hyderabad engineering team and act as the day\-to\-day product partner for development squads building and enhancing the RightHub platform.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who can bridge product strategy and engineering execution. The Product Owner will translate product direction, customer needs, roadmap priorities, and platform requirements into clear, actionable backlog items for the engineering team. They will work closely with global Product Managers and Product Leadership to ensure the Hyderabad team understands not only what needs to be built, but why it matters.
   

  

 Experience in intellectual property management software, legal technology, SaaS, enterprise software, or workflow\-heavy platforms is highly valuable, but not required. More important is the ability to learn a complex domain, communicate clearly, manage detail, and help engineering teams deliver high\-quality software. Proficiency in AI automation using agents is a big plus.
   

  

**You’ll Love This Job If You Enjoy**
 Product Ownership and Backlog Management
   

  

* Own and manage the product backlog for one or more RightHub engineering squads in Hyderabad.
* Translate roadmap priorities, product requirements, customer needs, and stakeholder input into well\-structured user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure backlog items are clear, refined, prioritized, and ready for development.
* Work with Product Managers and Product Leadership to understand strategic priorities and convert them into executable delivery plans.
* Balance new feature development, technical improvements, customer commitments, defects, and platform modernization work.


 Working Closely with Engineering
   

  

* Serve as the primary local product contact for developers, QA engineers, architects, and technical leads.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups where appropriate, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Clarify requirements quickly and remove product\-related blockers for the development team.
* Support engineering in making sensible trade\-offs between customer value, usability, technical feasibility, scalability, and delivery timelines.
* Ensure the team has sufficient business and product context to make good implementation decisions.


 Requirements and Acceptance Criteria
   

  

* Write clear user stories, functional requirements, acceptance criteria, process flows, and edge\-case scenarios.
* Define expected product behavior across user roles, permissions, workflows, integrations, notifications, and data states.
* Work with QA to ensure test scenarios reflect real customer usage and business\-critical workflows.
* Support UX/UI teams by providing context around user needs, business processes, and desired outcomes.
* Validate completed work against acceptance criteria before release or handover.


 Product and Domain Understanding
   

  

* Develop a strong understanding of the RightHub platform, including its modules, architecture, customer workflows, and role within Anaqua’s broader product suite.
* Build knowledge of intellectual property management processes, including patents, trademarks, deadlines, documents, matters, portfolios, renewals, docketing, and customer collaboration workflows.
* Work with internal subject matter experts to understand the needs of law firms, corporate IP departments, and other platform users.
* Ensure product decisions are grounded in customer value and operational reality.


 Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

* Collaborate with global Product Managers and Product Leadership.
* Help communicate development progress, risks, dependencies, and scope changes to relevant stakeholders.
* Support demos, internal enablement, release preparation, and documentation where needed.
* Act as a key connector between the Hyderabad engineering team and global product stakeholders.


 Delivery Quality and Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Help ensure that delivered functionality is complete, usable, reliable, and aligned with product expectations.
* Identify areas where requirements, backlog processes, handoffs, or delivery ceremonies can be improved.
* Support a culture of ownership, accountability, quality, and continuous learning within the team.
* Contribute to stronger product delivery practices as the Hyderabad team scales.


**Required Experience And Skills**
* Experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Product Manager, or similar role in a software product environment.
* Strong experience working directly with software engineering teams in an Agile/Scrum delivery model.
* Ability to write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional requirements.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to understand complex workflows, data structures, and business rules.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain product needs clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage ambiguity.
* Ability to prioritize effectively and make practical trade\-offs.
* Comfortable working with distributed teams across different time zones.
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Figma, Miro, or similar product delivery tools.


**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**
* Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, legal technology, intellectual property software, workflow automation, document management, CRM, ERP, or case/matter management platforms.

**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in product management, or a related technical role, including 3 years of people management experience


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience applying AI/ML (including Generative AI or Large Language Models) to solve complex business or user problems, particularly in areas like customer support, sales enablement, workflow automation, or policy issues.
* Experience with or strong understanding of the Google Ads ecosystem and advertiser needs.
* Experience working in a complex, cross\-functional organization, and influencing senior executives (e.g., Sales, Support, Policy, Engineering leadership).
* Highly analytical with strong problem solving, data analysis skills as well as proven business judgment.


**About The Job**
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
   

  

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
   

  

 One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
   

  

 Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and execute a multi\-year AI product goal and roadmap, addressing critical advertiser issues and leveraging data and user insights from advertisers, sellers, and support agents.
* Align goal and land product roadmaps and features across a wide variety of cross\-functional partners and leadership. Collaborate effectively with engineering teams to translate product goal into technical specifications and solutions, particularly involving complex AI/ML applications.
* Partner closely with design, engineering, research, sales, and support operations to ensure cohesive product development and successful launches for High Touch Services.
* Advocate deeply for users, establish domain expertise in advertiser challenges, and understand how they derive value from ads and support. When our partners succeed, we succeed.
* Clearly communicate the product goal and value proposition to stakeholders across CE, Ads, GBO, Sales, and Support leadership.

This is a builder's role: you will be expected to get deep into the details, move fast, and take end\-to\-end ownership of a product that has direct and visible impact on day\-to\-day operations of our Managed Services team. **Description**
 Amazon's travel, events, and expense programmes serve employees at an unprecedented scale, with a mission to deliver an employee\-centric experience that lets them be more productive, while also helping to manage costs, safety, and sustainability. Today that experience is fragmented across too many systems, partners, and manual processes. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager \- Technical to own the product strategy that consolidates these into a unified platform, dramatically reducing cost\-to\-serve while delivering a self\-service experience employees prefer over the alternatives.
   

  

 You'll partner with engineering, science, and design teams alongside third\-party partners to deliver intelligent automation, personalized experiences, and modern customer service capabilities. AI\-powered intelligent personalization and automation are tools in your toolkit, not the job description itself. You should be energized by applying them to genuinely eliminate friction, not just modernize the wrapper around legacy processes. This requires someone who takes ownership of ambiguous problems, makes hard build\-vs\-buy calls, and delivers measurable results at pace.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define product requirements for self\-service capabilities that reduce support contacts, eliminate manual work, and cut expense processing time.
* Evaluate and apply emerging AI capabilities for knowledge orchestration, intelligent routing, and agentic automation, to deliver measurable product improvements.
* Collaborate with technical programme managers and engineering teams to translate product vision into high\-quality technical solutions
* Drive the product strategy for shifting from fragmented third\-party dependencies to first\-party platform ownership, informing build\-vs\-buy decisions that permanently restructure the cost base
* Lead and develop a team of product managers and analysts; hire bar\-raising talent
* Influence cross\-functional global teams across finance, HR, and workplace technology to resolve dependencies and deliver shared outcomes
* Partner with customer services teams to set new program\-level success metrics (adoption, cost\-to\-serve, customer satisfaction) and use data to drive prioritization
* Write compelling narratives, strategy documents, and business cases to contribute to executive alignment, investment, and cross\-organizational resourcing for transformation initiatives


 A day in the life
   

  

 Start with a backlog review with your team, sharpening acceptance criteria for a self\-service workflow that eliminates a manual handoff. Move to a design sprint with engineers where you're debating trade\-offs between two integration approaches and deciding which to prototype first. Progress with synthesizing customer feedback into a revised requirements doc, then pressure\-testing priorities with an existing third\-party partner. End the day with a quick check on adoption metrics from last month's release, turning what you learn into next sprint's input. You build first, then let the data tell you what to build next.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Amazon Travel \& Events exists to make every business trip and event seamless, safe, and cost\-effective for over 500,000 employees across 64 countries. Our Technology \& Data Solutions team is the builder behind that mission, designing the platforms and data capabilities that let employees plan, book, and manage travel and events and expense re\-imbursements with as little effort as possible. We partner across Amazon's enterprise to improve the employee experience, reduce programme costs, strengthen duty of care, and advance sustainability goals. We're a mix of builders, analysts, and domain experts united by one principle: make it easy.

* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* 7\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Experience working with global teams and diverse partners

jobs.title: Database Administrator II
jobs.description:
While our core infrastructure heavily relies on Microsoft SQL Server, you will also be the dedicated expert supporting Couchbase.
  

If you enjoy variety in your day\-to\-day work, thrive in a multi\-tenant environment, and want to leverage both relational and NoSQL expertise, this is the perfect opportunity for you.


  
* Database Maintenance: Monitor, maintain, and optimize SQL Server databases for general company operations, while ensuring high performance and availability of the Couchbase .
* Performance Tuning: Optimize complex T\-SQL queries and indexes in SQL Server, and tune N1QL queries, indexing (GSI), and bucket configurations in Couchbase.
* High Availability \& Disaster Recovery: Manage backups, restores, replication, and failover strategies (including SQL Server AlwaysOn Availability Groups ).
* Collaboration \& Consulting: Work closely with software engineers and product owners from to assist with schema design, data modeling, and best practices.
* Security \& Compliance: Maintain strict data security, access controls, and compliance standards across all supported database platforms.

  
* Experience: 3\+ years of professional experience as a Database Administrator supporting production environments.
* SQL Server Expertise: Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server management, T\-SQL development, performance tuning, and high\-availability configurations.
* Couchbase Knowledge: Practical experience managing Couchbase clusters, monitoring bucket health, and writing/optimizing N1QL queries.
* Adaptability: Proven ability to context\-shift and support different tech stacks and stakeholder.
* Infrastructure: Experience working with Windows and Linux servers, as well as cloud\-based database deployments.
* Automation: Proficiency in scripting (PowerShell) to automate routine maintenance tasks across environments.
* Communication: Excellent English communication skills, with the ability to translate technical database concepts to different development teams.

As Web Experience and Operations Lead, you will have an excellent opportunity to be at the forefront of Novartis Next Generation Customer Engagement transformation. You will be accountable for delivering outstanding and consistent web experiences you will work with marketing, medical, digital and technology teams to define and bring to life a data\-driven and performance\-optimized web strategy for international markets.
### **About the Role**

Location: Hyderabad \#Hybrid


Responsibilities  

  

We are looking for an individual well\-versed on Web CMS (Drupal). As a Product Expert, He/she/they will perform:

* **Strategic Web Experience Leadership**


Operationalize the global Drupal Web Strategy, turning goals into clear roadmaps and periodized backlogs  

Champion best practices in UX, content, accessibility, and web performance to drive high\-quality, consistent experience across markets  

Align web roadmap and governance with enterprise priorities, brand guidelines and compliance requirements

* **Demand Management**


Review and triage incoming requests and tickets from country teams.  

Assess priority, propose viable alternatives, and collaborate with Product Owners and DDIT to define scalable solutions as appropriate.  

Represent the voice of the countries and ensure solution alignment with business needs.

* **Project Planning \& Coordination**


Collaborate with the Product Team \& DDIT Team to define the release scope, goals, deliverables, and timelines for Drupal releases.  

Schedule Product Demo sessions and ensure participation from the country stakeholders in those sessions.

Actively participate in walkthroughs and issue resolution meetings.

Ensure testing is completed within the agreed test window to avoid project delays.

* **Quality Assurance \& Sign\-Off**


Maintain high standards of documentation and traceability throughout the release lifecycle.  

Perform smoke testing to ensure application quality with the new releases.

 **Essential Requirements**


Hands on experience in Drupal CMS with experience working on large, complex projects across regions
  

Proactive, ownership\-driven problem solver who turns objectives into clear plans and outcomes with minimal guidance

Strong communication skills and ability to offer simple explanation of complexity.  

Strong collaborative skills and natural curiosity with ability to guide and clearly communicate delivery approach to the team members

jobs.description:
**Join the Team Modernizing Medicine**
 At
 **ModMed** 
 , we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach:
 **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** 
 This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI\-enabled, specialty\-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.
   

  

**A Culture of Excellence**
 When You Join ModMed, You’re Joining An Award\-winning Team Recognized For Innovation And Employee Satisfaction. From Our Global Headquarters In Boca Raton Florida, And Extensive Employee Base In Hyderabad India, We Are a Team Of 4,500\+ Passionate Problem\-solvers On a Mission To Increase Medical Practice Success And Improve Patient Outcomes
   

  

* Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work
* 2025 Globee Business Awards: Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”
* 2025 Black Book Awards: Ranked \#1 EHR in 11 Specialties
* Florida Venture Forum: Venture\-Backed Company of the Year


 We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.
   

  

**Ready to modernize medicine with us?**
**Job Description Summary**
****Technical Product Owner (Practice Management \& AI Innovation)****
**Department: Product Management**
****The Mission****
 At ModMed, we are placing doctors and patients at the center of care through an intelligent, specialty\-specific cloud platform. We are looking for a Technical Product Owner who doesn’t just manage a backlog, but actively shapes a world where software increases medical\-practice success and improves patient outcomes.
   

  

****The Role****
 You will serve as the strategic bridge between vision and velocity. As the liaison for our Practice Management product, you will leverage your deep medical billing knowledge and technical SQL skills to translate complex business needs into groundbreaking AI and automation\-driven features.
   

  

****How You’ll Make an Impact****
* Drive the AI Revolution: You won't just follow a roadmap; you’ll elicit, analyze, and validate requirements for AI\-driven logic and automation triggers that redefine the "modern" in ModMed.
* Innovate Boldly: Translate business needs into high\-fidelity functional requirements, including technical specifications and workflow diagrams that define the future of practice automation.
* Save Time (Quantifiably): Identify operational bottlenecks using data\-driven metrics and propose automation solutions that reduce manual effort and maximize financial outcomes for our clients.
* Collaborate \& Align: Partner with Engineering and Product Management to navigate the development lifecycle—addressing edge cases, ensuring scalability, and maintaining the highest standards of model accuracy.
* Champion Change: Coordinate alpha/beta programs to gather the "voice of the customer," ensuring our AI initiatives create genuine Customer Delight before they hit the general market.
* Think Big: Support release readiness by creating the "source of truth" documentation and training materials that empower our internal teams to succeed.


****What You Bring****
* Healthcare Core: You have deep\-rooted experience in Healthcare or Practice Management. You understand the heartbeat of a medical office.
* Technical Edge: You are proficient in SQL for data validation and problem investigation. You enjoy "looking under the hood" to ensure data integrity.
* The "Automation" Mindset: You are fascinated by AI capabilities and have the analytical rigor to design solutions that are compliant, scalable, and intuitive.
* Communication Mastery: You can explain complex AI logic to a stakeholder and technical constraints to a designer without breaking a sweat.
* Self\-Starter DNA: You manage high\-visibility projects with minimal supervision, balancing competing priorities with a focus on Doing Good.


****Our Culture \& Values****
 We believe in Aligning Passion with Purpose. At ModMed, you’ll find a team that moves fast, stays curious, and treats "fun" as a requirement, not an option.
   

  

* Create Customer Delight in every feature.
* Innovate Boldly, then make things happen.
* Save Time for the people who save lives.


****Why ModMed?****
* Innovation\-First: Work on true AI/Automation projects that have a direct impact on healthcare providers.
* Specialty\-Specific: We don’t do "one size fits all"—we build intelligent tools for specific medical needs.
* Growth: This is a high\-visibility role with a direct line to product leadership and the opportunity to own a critical piece of our PM platform.


***ModMed Benefits Highlight:***

* Meals \& Snacks: Enjoy complimentary office lunches \& dinners on select days and healthy snacks delivered to your desk,
* Insurance Coverage: Comprehensive health, accidental, and life insurance plans, including coverage for family members, all at no cost to employees,
* Allowances: Annual wellness allowance to support your well\-being and productivity,
* Earned, casual, and sick leaves to maintain a healthy work\-life balance,
* Bereavement leave for difficult times and extended medical leave options,
* Paid parental leaves, including maternity, paternity, adoption, surrogacy, and abortion leave,
* Celebration leave to make your special day even more memorable, and company\-paid holidays to recharge and unwind.

We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. jobs.description:
**The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to embed on\-site with one of CAW's enterprise customers — sitting with their functional leaders, understanding their workflows, identifying the highest\-ROI automation opportunities, and prototyping solutions yourself using AI\-assisted development tools like Claude Code or OpenAI Codex.
   

  

 This is not a project management role. We are looking for someone with strong business analysis chops who can walk into a domain they've never worked in, study it quickly, break down complex workflows, and figure out what to build. You should have a coding background and be able to prototype working solutions yourself — not just write specs and hand them off. You stay involved throughout production so nothing is lost in the communication between the customer and our remote engineers.
   

  

 You are the one person the customer sees. The building and running happen behind you, at CAW HQ, on Gantry.
   

  

**A Typical Week**
**Monday–Tuesday:** 
 Interview functional leaders and their team members to gain a deep understanding of their current processes, pain points, and undocumented workflows. Map what you find.
   

  

**Wednesday:** 
 Apply structured prioritization frameworks (RICE, ICE, or equivalent) to rank discovered use cases by ROI. Classify each problem as deterministic automation, AI automation, an AI agent (built on Gantry), or a Custom Ops Platform (COP) opportunity — and draft the solution approach in collaboration with CAW's engineering and AI architects at HQ.
   

  

**Thursday:** 
 Present the top problems and proposed solutions to the functional leader for buy\-in. Get alignment on what to tackle first.
   

  

**Friday and the following week:** 
 Prototype the solution using Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent AI\-assisted development tools. Target: a working prototype in under a week. Present the prototype to the functional team, collect feedback, and iterate until it meets their needs. Once validated, draft a proposal to productionize it on Gantry (or as a COP) in collaboration with HQ, and drive approval from the functional head.
   

  

**Ongoing:** 
 Spend a few hours daily collaborating with CAW's engineering teams at HQ to keep productionizing on track — while simultaneously starting discovery on the next problem with the next functional leader.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Use Case Mining \& Discovery**
* Embed on\-site with the customer. Sit with functional leaders across departments — operations, finance, CX, supply chain, HR — to understand their workflows, pain points, and priorities.
* Don't wait for requirements to be handed to you. Proactively identify problems CAW can solve with agents on Gantry or with a Custom Ops Platform. Prioritize ruthlessly based on business impact, technical feasibility, and speed to value.
* Run structured discovery sessions. Map workflows. Document undocumented processes. Find the use cases the customer doesn't even know they have.
* Build a use\-case pipeline: a ranked, living backlog of agent and COP opportunities for you and the customer's leadership to review regularly. This backlog is how the account grows.


**Solution Design \& Rapid Prototyping**
* Classify each problem as deterministic automation, AI automation, an AI agent, or a COP. Draft solution approaches in collaboration with CAW HQ architects.
* Prototype solutions yourself using Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent AI\-assisted development tools. A working demo in under a week is the standard.
* Translate validated prototypes into structured specs — clear problem statements, acceptance criteria, scope boundaries, and success metrics — that CAW's engineers can productionize on Gantry without ambiguity.
* Work in tight weekly cycles: discover, prototype, validate, spec, hand off for production — and stay involved through delivery.


**Customer Relationship \& Adoption**
* You represent CAW inside the customer's organization. Build deep trust with functional leaders and CXOs.
* Own delivery timelines, customer expectations, and escalations. You are the single point of accountability the customer sees.
* Ensure what gets built is what gets used. Drive adoption by working with the customer's end users, running training sessions, and instrumenting usage metrics.
* Know when to push (the customer is avoiding a hard decision) and when to listen (there's a real constraint you haven't understood yet).


**Platform \& Product Feedback Loop**
* Surface structured insights back to the Gantry product team: capability gaps, integration friction, customer objections, and use case patterns that should become reusable agents or platform features.
* Spot which agents and patterns are reusable across customers so they can be added to CAW's library and accelerate the next engagement. Flag when a customer ask is a one\-off vs. when it's a pattern many customers share.
* Deliver actionable, prioritized field intelligence — not a dump of Slack messages. Your feedback directly informs the Gantry roadmap.


**What We're Looking For**
* 4–7 years of experience in a customer\-facing product or business analysis role, such as Product Manager, Business Analyst, Solutions Consultant, or Forward Deployed Engineer at a SaaS/AI company.
* Coding background \- You have written code professionally or as part of product work. You understand APIs, data flows, and system architecture well enough to prototype, not just spec.
* Demonstrable AI\-assisted development experience. Show us products, prototypes, or internal tools you have built using Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, or equivalent tools. We want to see output, not claims.
* Heavy business analysis experience. You have demonstrable examples of walking into a domain with vague or undefined requirements, studying it deeply, and cracking the problem. We are not looking for project managers who track tickets — we want people who figure out what the tickets should be.

jobs.title: Healthcare Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

Healthcare Data Analyst
  
Roche India – Roche Services\& Solutions
  
Chennai / Hyderabad
  
  

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  

Who we are
  
Roche has established the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics\& technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
  
  

The candidate will have an option to join Chennai or Hyderabad office and would be required to come to office in a hybrid mode \- the number of days the candidate is required to be in person in the office lies with the management and might change as required by the business.
  
  

**The Opportunity:**  

As aHealthcare Data Analyst,you will play a critical role in reading, understanding, and assessing the medical and pharmacy policies of US Health Insurance companies (also called payers) based on the criteria defined by the subject matter experts. This role requires excellent communication skills, as the Sr Analyst will be responsible for distilling complex policy information into understandable terms and engaging effectively with stakeholders to ensure compliance and alignment with our objectives.
  
  

* Conduct detailed reviews of medical and pharmacy policies from various US Health Insurance Companies across Commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid plans and formulary validation.
* Assess these policies in the context of our guidelines\& criteria such as payer coverage criteria, formulary status, prior authorization (PA), step therapy (ST), and other utilization management (UM) restrictions as established by the business leads.
* Utilize analytics tools and methodologies to generate insights, providing recommendations for business improvements.
* Act as a thought partner, collaborating with internal teams to strategize and optimize business processes\& rules based on analytical findings.
* Clearly communicate findings, implications, and recommendations to internal teams and external partners; ensuring complex information is easily interpretable.
* Develop and maintain documentation related to policy assessments and compliance activities.
* Contribute to the internal initiatives, which includes adhoc projects and employee engagement programs.


**Who you are:**  

* You hold a bachelor's degree in Life Sciences (Pharmacology, Dentistry, or a related field) and 2 to 5 years of experience in Pharma/Healthcare (pharmacovigilance, insurance, health IT).
* Certification in SQL, Power BI, or similar technical skills is preferred
* Prior experience in the corporate healthcare industry is required.
* Experience in healthcare policy, insurance, compliance, or related areas with solid knowledge of US healthcare regulations is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with secondary data sources such as FDA databases, Redbook, and clinical labels is preferred.
* Strong analytical mindset with keen attention to detail, able to communicate complex information clearly and concisely.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with proven stakeholder engagement skills; effective team member in a cross functional and dynamic environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 and Google Suite Workspace.
* Technical expertise in Excel required; working knowledge of SQL and Python or similar programming language is good to have.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities effectively.


Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.

jobs.title: Specialist IS Bus Sys Analyst
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
 Role Description:
   

  

 Let's do this. Let's change the world. We are looking for a highly motivated Specialist IS Business Systems Analyst to support Amgen's Manufacturing Applications Product Team across custom applications focused on finite scheduling, predictive maintenance, and AI\-enabled plant operations.
   

  

 This role is grounded in strong business analyst practices and will be key in eliciting, documenting, refining, and validating business requirements for custom manufacturing applications. The role supports two related workstreams: finite scheduling applications, and AI\-centric operational applications such as Equipment Copilot and PlantPulse. The role partners with manufacturing SMEs, product owners, platform leads, developers, and external vendors to translate plant needs into clear requirements, inform backlog prioritization, coordinate testing, and support adoption of capabilities that replace spreadsheet\-driven and legacy workflows. The team uses AI\-assisted tools in day\-to\-day analysis, documentation, and delivery workflows, and the ideal candidate can connect plant operations needs with business process design, release readiness, and practical application delivery across the portfolio.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead requirements elicitation and process discovery sessions with site SMEs and business stakeholders across the manufacturing scheduling and adjacent operations application portfolio.
* Translate business needs into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and prioritized backlog items that can be executed by development and vendor teams, while simplifying requirements in ways that reduce redundant, time\-consuming steps and identify automation opportunities.
* Partner with product owners, project managers, and delivery teams to maintain and prioritize the product backlog, support sprint planning, backlog grooming, demos, and defect triage.
* Assess enhancement requests and solution options with technical leads and vendors, including feasibility, business impact, rollout sequencing, and dependency management.
* Support application sustainment, enhancement, and lifecycle improvements across production scheduling applications used at multiple manufacturing sites.
* Coordinate requirements and testing for changes involving upstream and downstream manufacturing systems, data flows, and planning integrations.
* Document current\-state and future\-state workflows, business rules, master or reference data needs, and application behavior needed to scale the tools to new plants or use cases.
* Create and maintain business requirements, process documentation, test artifacts, training materials, and release documentation with clear traceability to business outcomes.
* Develop test plans, UAT scenarios, and regression test cases for each sprint or release, and coordinate execution with SMEs to validate requirements coverage.
* Manage defect intake, business impact clarification, and resolution follow\-up with development teams and vendors to drive timely closure of open issues.
* Support release readiness activities including stakeholder alignment, access enablement, communications, production cutover coordination, and adoption planning.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual scheduling effort, improve data quality, standardize decision\-making, and retire legacy spreadsheet\-driven or manual planning workflows.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Hiring Primitives
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.


Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

 **About the role**


The product team owns Rippling’s product direction, defining what to build in order to solve customer problems in a way that allows them to succeed and for our business to thrive. We do this by distilling insights from user research, product\-generated data, competitive analysis, and a deep market understanding. These insights allow us to prioritize the features we work on, which we define end to end with our design and engineering counterparts, to create our roadmap. As the features on this roadmap get developed, we partner with various teams to ensure they are ready to sell, service, and support them. We iterate on these features using data and customer feedback to make sure that they fulfill and surpass the goals we had when we decided to build them.


In this role, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for Rippling's hiring primitives platform. Your mission is to build the systems that make enterprise and global hiring adaptable, configurable, and scalable across countries, entities, worker types, and employment models. Success means enabling customers to hire and manage employees anywhere in the world through a flexible platform that supports country\-specific requirements while maintaining a unified product experience. You will partner closely with engineering, design, legal, compliance, operations, and go\-to\-market teams to define and launch foundational hiring capabilities used across HRIS, EOR, and Payroll products.

 **What you will do**

* Own the roadmap and execution for Rippling's global hiring primitives and workforce configuration platform.
* Understand in detail the legal, compliance, operational, and regulatory requirements related to an employee’s early lifecycle.
* Build foundational capabilities that enable enterprise and global hiring to be adaptable and customizable across countries and entities.
* Conduct market research and customer analysis to understand what will need to be built and how to prioritize it for each country.
* Go beyond just shipping new countries; you obsess about continuous improvement and can optimize for shipping a portfolio of small, medium, and large releases.
* Do whatever it takes to make your countries and team successful, no matter how big or small the issue may be.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, design, other product teams, operations, legal, and compliance, to ensure successful product development and launch.
* Define product requirements and create detailed specifications, user stories, and wireframes to guide development.
* Participate in agile software development processes and work with the engineering team to ensure the product is delivered on time and within budget.
* Communicate with key stakeholders, including customers, sales, marketing, and customer support, to gather feedback and ensure that the product meets their needs.
* Oversee the testing and quality assurance of the payroll product, including conducting user acceptance testing.

 **What you will need**

* 4\+ years of Product Management experience
* Self\-starter with a bias toward action
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* Possess a deep sense of ownership and responsibility and understand that the buck stops with you.
* Endless curiosity and a love of the nitty\-gritty details
* Owned a successful product from inception to launch
* Strong ability to motivate and inspire people to do their best work
* Relentlessly focused on customers’ needs
* Exceptional interpersonal communication, relationship management, and organizational skills
* Deep analytical, prioritization, and problem\-solving skills
* Strong alignment with our core values: We Run Hard, We Push the Limits of Possible, and Never Not My Problem

**About the role**
------------------

The Pod Lead Engineer is a hands‑on software engineering specialist who leads a small, outcome‑focused delivery pod of 4–5 Pod Engineers. The role combines deep technical contribution with day‑to‑day pod leadership, enabling faster delivery through AI‑assisted / AI‑orchestrated SDLC practices.
  

Unlike a traditional team lead role, the Pod Lead Engineer operates in an AI‑native delivery model where AI tools and agents are used across the SDLC to accelerate requirements understanding, design, code generation, testing, documentation, and release readiness. The Pod Lead Engineer is accountable for technical direction, delivery execution, and engineering quality, while maintaining high standards of security, compliance, and operational excellence.


**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

**1\) Hands‑On Delivery Leadership (Core)**  

* Lead a 4–5 engineer pod by building software alongside the team, taking ownership of design, coding, reviews, and integration while breaking work into small, deliverable increments using modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automated testing, code quality gates).
* Drive frequent delivery of working software by ensuring clear definitions of done, measurable progress, and strong accountability for end‑to‑end delivery outcomes.
**2\)AI‑Enabled SDLC Execution**  

* Embed AI across SDLC stages (requirements, design, build, test, deploy, operate) to accelerate solution design, safely generate/refactor code, create tests/automation, and support reviews and documentation.
* Establish pod‑level practices to maximize productivity with clear human accountability for decisions and release readiness, while maintaining required gates (e.g., quality checks, approvals) aligned to organizational standards.
**3\)Technical Direction \& Engineering Quality**  

* Act as the pod’s technical authority, defining architecture (within guardrails), patterns, component design, and integration approach.
* Own code quality, maintainability, performance, reliability, and security, while establishing pod‑level engineering standards (branching, coding conventions, reviews, testing, CI/CD hygiene).
**4\)Pod Management (Small Team Leadership)**  

* Provide day‑to‑day leadership for a 4–5 engineer pod, including task allocation, pairing strategy, prioritization, and removing blockers.
* Coach engineers in AI‑native ways of working (prompting, evaluation, safe AI use) while driving continuous improvement through retrospectives, root cause analysis, and measurable cycle‑time and quality gains.
**5\)Stakeholder Alignment \& Outcome Ownership**  

* Partner with the Senior Manager, AI Engineering and business/product stakeholders to clarify outcomes, scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria, translating needs into clear technical milestones and deliverable increments.
* Provide transparent updates on progress, risks, dependencies, and mitigation actions to ensure strong alignment and end‑to‑end outcome ownership.
**6\)Governance, Risk, and Responsible Engineering**  

* Ensure adherence to security, data protection, and engineering governance standards while proactively managing risks from AI‑assisted development (e.g., licensing, security vulnerabilities, hallucinated code, weak tests).
* Maintain required auditable artefacts (documentation, traceability, approvals) aligned with enterprise expectations for controlled delivery.
**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Strong experience as a senior software engineer / technical lead / engineering specialist delivering production systems.
* Solid engineering fundamentals: API design (REST), data modelling, testing strategy, CI/CD, secure coding, reliability practices.
* Proven expertise in Java or .NET or Python along with UI and backend technologies like React, Flutter, PostgreSQL, Neptune DB.
* Strong credentials in Cloud environments like AWS.
* Proven experience leading small delivery groups (e.g., squad/pod/team) and delivering iteratively.
* Practical experience using AI development tools (Copilot, Amazon Kiro, Claude Code, agent workflows, automated test generation, AI‑assisted documentation).
**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Experience working in AI‑assisted / agentic delivery models or rapid delivery “pods” / cohort models.
* Familiarity with governance practices that support quality and assurance in delivery environments (e.g., gate reviews, readiness checks).

Sumo Logic is seeking a Product Manager to define the future of our Security Operations platform. As a member of our product team, you will drive the vision and execution of Threat Detection and Response and define the intersection of AI and SecOps. Working across engineering, customer success, sales, and marketing, you will transform complex challenges into intuitive, powerful solutions that enable security teams to: detect threats faster, investigate with confidence, and respond decisively. This is an opportunity to shape products that directly impact how enterprises defend against evolving cyber threats while delivering measurable business value to customers.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Defining the vision, strategy, and roadmap for an exceptional user experience and innovative Threat Detection and Response features that drive customer engagement and satisfaction across our platform.
* Collaborating with customers and stakeholders to gather and analyze user feedback, use cases, and requirements to ensure we meet their needs while enhancing the overall platform user experience.
* Maintaining a detailed product roadmap supported by data analysis and competitive positioning to prioritize features and enhancements effectively.
* Working with cross\-functional teams to identify and gather platform requirements that enhance user experience and dashboard functionalities.
* Representing the voice of the customer to product engineering teams and executives, ensuring user needs are at the forefront of product development.
* Partnering with engineering teams to ensure our dashboarding solutions are scalable, reliable, and performant, making prioritization decisions as necessary.
* Contributing to go\-to\-market strategies, collaborating with product marketing and sales to effectively communicate the value of our user experience and dashboarding capabilities.
* Developing sales enablement materials, including whitepapers, blogs, presentations, and product demos to showcase our dashboarding features.


**What You Bring**
* 3\+ years of experience in product management, preferably with a focus on cybersecurity, and a proven track record of success in execution
* Strong understanding of security operations technologies (SIEM, SOAR, XDR, Threat Intelligence)
* Experience in working with B2B SaaS products and the ability to navigate complex decision\-making environments.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with a proven track record of effectively engaging with customers and cross\-functional teams.
* A data\-driven mindset, with the ability to use analytics to inform product decisions and prioritize development efforts.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; an MBA is a plus.


**Why Join Sumo Logic?**
 You will be working on one of the largest scale data problems in the industry. Your work directly impacts the company’s bottom line and determines our ability to innovate by freeing up capital for new product investments.
   

  

**About Us**
 Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI\-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

jobs.description:
**Senior Product Manager I \- Agent Platform \& Governance**
 Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager I to help define how AI agents, MCP clients, and enterprise workflows safely interact with the Sumo Logic platform.
   

  

 As AI becomes a broader interface for accessing data, insights, and platform capabilities, customers need confidence that every agentic workflow is secure, governed, auditable, and aligned with enterprise controls. This role will own key product areas across MCP strategy, agent governance, headless invocation, agent\-to\-agent integrations, RBAC, rate limiting, throttling, quotas, admin controls, and auditability.
   

  

 You will work closely with engineering, architecture, security, AI, platform, and customer\-facing teams to turn ambiguous platform and governance needs into scalable product capabilities. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can operate at the intersection of technical platform depth, enterprise customer trust, and fast\-moving AI product strategy.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Own product strategy and execution for MCP and governed agent access to Sumo Logic capabilities.
* Define how agents, tools, skills, APIs, and external clients can safely interact with the Sumo Logic platform.
* Drive requirements for headless agent invocation, including access patterns across external clients, partner tools, IDEs, terminals, Slack, and other future surfaces.
* Shape Sumo Logic’s approach to agent\-to\-agent integrations, including invocation boundaries, trust models, permissioning, and auditability.
* Define governance models for tools, skills, agents, context, memory, and reusable content across the AI platform.
* Partner with engineering and architecture on rate limiting, throttling, quotas, tenant isolation, abuse prevention, and safe defaults for agentic workflows.
* Drive product requirements for RBAC, data access controls, service accounts, OAuth/API access, service allowlisting, and admin\-configured policies as they apply to agents and MCP\-based access.
* Define enterprise admin controls for managing agent access, approved tools, accessible content, long\-term memory, context sources, and policy enforcement.
* Ensure agentic actions are observable, auditable, permission\-aware, and explainable to enterprise admins.
* Translate strategic direction into crisp PRDs, proposals, user stories, acceptance criteria, and phased rollout plans.
* Use telemetry to monitor agent usage, MCP adoption, tool calls, rate\-limit hits, permission failures, policy violations, latency, and operational reliability.
* Create leadership\-facing proposals that clearly explain tradeoffs across customer demand, governance, platform complexity, and long\-term architecture.


 What You Bring
   

  

* 4\+ years of product management experience, ideally in enterprise SaaS, cloud platforms, security, IAM, APIs, AI platforms, developer platforms, observability, or security products.
* Strong technical product instincts around permissions, governance, APIs, platform architecture, admin controls, and enterprise\-scale systems.
* Familiarity with AI agent concepts such as MCP, tools, skills, agent orchestration, headless invocation, agent\-to\-agent workflows, context, memory, and guardrails.
* Strong understanding of enterprise controls such as RBAC, OAuth, API keys, service accounts, audit logs, policy enforcement, rate limits, throttling, quotas, and data access boundaries.
* Ability to ask the right questions, identify edge cases, and think through how product capabilities behave under real enterprise constraints.
* Strong analytical skills; comfortable using telemetry, dashboards, SQL, and usage data to understand adoption, friction, failures, and risk.
* Strong communication skills across both technical and business audiences.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, POS Application Platform
jobs.description:
**Who we are**  

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa's all\-in\-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross\-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria's largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country's point\-of\-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.  

  

**About the role**  

  

More than 6 million businesses run their financial lives through Moniepoint — and the primary way they interact with us every single day is through a POS device. For most of our merchants, that device is their business. It is how they accept payments, how they access credit, and how they track their finances. Everything those devices are capable of, in terms of speed, reliability, and developer quality, flows from the engineering platform this role leads.



We are building a dedicated POS Application Platform function: the foundational engineering layer that sits beneath every POS product at Moniepoint. Think of it as the operating system for our POS engineering organisation — the standards, frameworks, tooling, and architectural backbone that every POS engineer across the business builds on top of. This is not a feature team. It is a platform team in the truest sense, and the Head of Engineering for POS Application Platform is the technical owner of that layer.



We currently operate across approximately five POS device types from multiple OEM manufacturers, all running on Android. The engineering challenges here span device governance, developer experience, platform reliability, foundational frameworks, and adoption across a distributed set of POS engineers working in separate product squads.



And the scope is only growing. We have a UK entity live, a cross\-border payments product in market, and a microfinance bank acquisition finalizing in Kenya. The platform you build will become the foundation for tens of millions of businesses across multiple markets to accept payments, access financial services, and grow. If you have spent your career going deep on POS systems and you want to build the platform that underpins one of Africa's most consequential fintech businesses during its global expansion, this is the role.


**What you'll get to do**


* Own the technical strategy and architecture for the POS Application Platform, acting as the domain CTO for everything that runs on our POS devices.
* Build and govern the four core platform pillars across the organisation: developer experience (tools, libraries, SDKs), platform reliability (observability, uptime, quality standards), foundational frameworks (architecture, coding standards, testing and release pipelines), and squad adoption (driving uptake of platform tooling across all embedded POS engineers).
* Define and enforce engineering standards across all POS device types and OEM manufacturers, ensuring architectural consistency and quality across a heterogeneous device fleet.
* Functionally lead POS engineers embedded across Payments, Onboarding, VAS, Savings, and Loans squads — setting the bar for engineering quality and providing the platform layer above all of them.
* Own POS observability end\-to\-end: monitoring, alerting, and incident response frameworks that ensure platform health across all devices and squads.
* Drive the architecture for how Moniepoint supports multiple POS device types, including defining how new devices are onboarded, governed, and integrated with the platform.
* Collaborate with OEM partners and the POS hardware team when new device types are introduced, ensuring the application layer is ready to support them from day one.
* Write and review code directly — this role expects 40 to 60 percent hands\-on engineering time. You will set the technical standard, not just the technical direction.
* Build and scale the POS platform team, including hiring, mentoring, and structuring for growth as the platform expands internationally.
* Translate platform decisions into business impact, working closely with Product, Payments, and Business leadership across markets.
* Establish and continuously improve engineering processes, tooling standards, CI/CD pipelines, and developer productivity metrics across the POS engineering community.


**To succeed in this role, we think you should have**


* A minimum of 10 years of hands\-on software engineering experience, with at least 6 years leading engineering teams through meaningful growth phases, ideally in multi\-national or large VC\-backed companies.
* Direct, hands\-on experience building software that runs on Point\-of\-Sale terminal devices. This means engineering on the device itself — the application layer — not server\-side integrations with POS systems. This is a non\-negotiable requirement and candidates without it will not be considered.
* Strong working knowledge of EMV standards (Europay, Mastercard, Visa) and experience navigating payment certification processes such as PCI DSS and P2PE. Candidates without this will not be considered.
* Deep Android engineering expertise in Kotlin and Java. The POS application layer at Moniepoint is Android\-based and there are no exceptions to this requirement.
* Proven experience building internal engineering platforms, shared libraries, developer tooling, or foundational frameworks used by other engineering teams — not just consumer\-facing feature products.
* Experience governing or architecting across multiple POS device types from different hardware manufacturers, with an understanding of how OEM integrations and device management work at scale.
* A track record of hands\-on technical leadership at a meaningful frequency — a 40 to 60 percent coding ratio in your current or most recent role is what we expect. If you have moved into a fully managerial role with no direct contribution to code, this role is likely not the right fit.
